name: The Viaduct Cake
summary: A side-on picture-book kitchen on Pip's sixth birthday. As his big sister Dot, you build his order, a landscape cake in a glass dish: you carve the hills yourself, pour a jam river that finds your valley, and add a Rich Tea viaduct, marzipan sheep and a cherry sun. All the while Dot's ledger of everything Pip got and she didn't keeps count, and you can even the score by eating bits of his valley. Then the folded bottom of his order is opened, you crouch to counter height to see the cake become a real landscape, and you reckon the ledger.
motifs: a grievance ledger in an exercise book
a carved sponge horizon in a glass dish
jam that finds the lowest point
a folded secret under a fridge magnet
a liquorice train over two marzipan children
thread: Saturday, nearly five, in Nan's kitchen. Dot (9) built her little brother Pip's birthday map cake: a sponge valley she carved herself, a purple jam river, a Rich Tea viaduct with arches Nan bit out, a liquorice train, some sheep (unless she ate them) and a cherry sun (or a cream cloud, if she ate the cherry). All afternoon she tallied in her private book everything Pip got and she didn't. Then the folded bottom of his order said what he really wanted: 'DOT. UNDER THE BRIDGE. HOLDING MY HAND LIKE WHEN THE TRAIN WENT OVER.' Two marzipan children now stand hand in hand under the arches, and Dot has reckoned her ledger one way or another. She has just knocked on the window for Pip. Unresolved: he hasn't seen the cake yet; the candles aren't lit; tea is at five; and Pip has his own secrets with Nan. Carried: Dot's ledger, Pip's unfolded order, the strawberry magnet.
delight: What I loved was the crouch: a child putting her eye level with the counter so the cake in front of her turns into a real horizon, and the hills in it are the ones the player cut with a knife a minute earlier, with jam pooled in whatever valley they made. I also liked Nan, who never tells anyone off and just reports the weather: 'Four sheep. Well. One's wandered.'

idea.name: The Viaduct Cake
idea.premise: On her little brother's sixth birthday, nine-year-old Dot helps Nan build the landscape cake he ordered (the railway viaduct, a purple river, five sheep, the sun) while keeping a secret ledger of every unfairness Pip has ever got away with. Every chance to even the score takes something out of his valley. The folded bottom of his order turns out to ask for her, and the jealousy turns into something you can stand on.
